new_packages.label: סֻכַּת הַקְּלִפָּה וְיְמִין שֶׁקֶר
new_packages.label_en: The Sukka of the Klipa and the False Right Hand
new_packages.reason: This is the evil mirror of Package 1 (סכה, חסד, חבוק). Torah 48's structural argument has a clear good/evil bifurcation: the holy sukka (covering, embrace, divine speech) has an exact evil counterpart. The evil sukka (סכת נוצרים / סכה דקלפה) arises from unholy speech; the false right hand (ימין שקר) is the evil embrace; the foreign tongues (ריב לשונות) that drown out holy prayer are the anti-prayer. The place 'מדבר צין' decodes as 'תמורה' — the substitution/replacement, the transformation of holy sukka into evil sukka. All these concepts share the essential nature of 'counterfeit sacred covering' — the klipa that mimics and inverts the holy sukka/chesed/embrace. This package requires the five additions listed in torah_48_additions.json.

mirror_structure.חבוק יד ימין / צל יד (pkg 1): חבוק דסטרא אחרא / ימין שקר (evil pkg)
mirror_structure.צירי / בינה / יצירה (pkg 1): מדבר צין / תמורה (evil pkg — the false formation/substitution)

threshold_check.reasoning: 5 proposed nodes with bechina language. Forms an independent evil domain (klipa/false covering). Has structural parallels to Package 1. Every proposed node has explicit bechina phrasing in the source text. Even at minimum (3 nodes: סכה דקלפה, ימין שקר, תמורה), it qualifies as an independent domain.

notes: The new package is conditioned on the five additions in torah_48_additions.json being accepted. If only the three most strongly attested evil nodes are accepted (סכה דקלפה = תמורה וחילוף, ימין שקר = חבוק דסטרא אחרא, מדבר צין = תמורה), the package still qualifies with 3+ nodes forming a clear independent evil domain. This is the most structurally significant gap in the current Torah 48 dataset: the entire evil mirror is unrepresented.
